albums.label: 金牌大風

tracks.title: 一早地下鐵 / 幾分鐘的約會
tracks.subtitle: Live (medley)

albums.sourceNotes: 2CD live album recorded at 2009 RubberBand Concert #1. Tracklist from Douban (music.douban.com/subject/4227658) and 2000fun forum, cross-checked with Shazam/Apple Music (25 tracks). CD1 = tracks 1-14, CD2 = tracks 15-25; track 25 (發現號) is a studio bonus track. Apple Music lists CD2 track 4 as 城堡 but Douban/2000fun give 城記 (the Apollo 18 song) — 城記 used. Apple Music shows release date 2009-01-01 (placeholder) and copyright 'Gold Typhoon Taiwan'; Douban/2000fun give 2009-12-30 and 金牌大風. All tracks are live versions; the MVs recorded below are the studio/official MVs of the same songs (except 阿波羅, whose official MV is cut from this concert). Many tracks lack MVs; search budget ran out before every track could be searched individually, so unsearched tracks are null.

DVD-only content (excluded from tracks): 1. 細街盃 MV (dir. 泥鯭), 2. SimpleLoveSong MV (dir. 阿正), 3. La grande aventure de Rubberband: la recherche du Lennoon (dir. 莊少榮), 4. 天連地 MV (dir. 阿正/泥鯭/6號). Track 9 title is written 'hello ?' on Douban/Wikipedia and 'Hello?' on Discogs. Singles per Wikipedia charts: 細街盃, 天連地, SimpleLoveSong (四台冠軍歌), 囍宴樂隊. MV searches for tracks 2,4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12 could not be completed (search budget exhausted) — null does not mean confirmed absent. Official MVs found are on the 'Timeless Music Hong Kong天碟' channel (Gold Typhoon/Warner catalogue channel), not the RubberBand channel.
